rounds.text: B C C Fuba India Ltd is demonstrating extraordinary fundamental momentum, backed by compounded sales growth of 54% and compounded profit growth of 56% over the trailing twelve months [E8, E9]. This superior operational delivery is validated by strong return metrics, featuring an ROCE of 18.4% and an ROE of 16.9%, both comfortably outperforming the sector medians of 12.2% [E6, E7, E58]. Furthermore, the business exhibits stellar cash realization, with operating cash flow reaching Rs 10.25 Cr in March 2026, representing 110% of operating profit and a healthy 1.78x cash conversion ratio [E17, E18, E20]. Capital efficiency is also visibly improving as working capital requirements have contracted sharply from 47.9 days to 27.8 days [E41], while the broader Information Technology sector provides a robust macro tailwind with a tailwind score of +0.60 [E53]. This operational excellence is strongly affirmed by the market, as evidenced by a relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500, a 127% one-year share price growth, and a technical setup where the price trades above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E13, E32, E33]. conceded: [E27], [E28], [E29], [E51], [E52].
